note: The free FLEX Shuttle stops at Mission Bay on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, about 43 minutes past each hour, 8:30 am to 5:30 pm. It goes to the Marina Community Center, Walmart and FoodMaxx on Hesperian, Bay Fair BART, Bayfair Center (Target) and the Senior Center.

items.name: FLEX RIDES sign-up, City of San Leandro
items.note: Free shuttle for San Leandro residents 50 and over or paratransit certified. Bring photo ID and proof of address. On Demand low-cost Uber rides, 24 hours, for members 70 and over.

items.name: East Bay Paratransit
items.note: Door-to-door rides. Apply first. Book 8 am to 5 pm daily, at least the day before.

items.name: RideCare volunteer drivers, medical trips, age 50 and over
AC Transit Line 35 and trip times
items.note: Stop at Wicks Blvd and Mission Bay, to Bay Fair BART or San Leandro BART. Seniors 65 and over ride half fare with a Senior Clipper card.

items.note: Bay Fair is closest. Seniors 65 and over get 62.5% off with a Senior Clipper card.
